name: Case law: United States, the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit
label: United States case law (the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit)
coverage: 79624 published opinions with text, one file and one commit each, dated the day decided; 4857 citations of the US Code linked to united-states/federal/usc.
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: every commit is Kind: court. In-force is the day decided. Commits before 1970 are dated 1970-01-01, a second apart; In-force holds the real day. The US Code record holds only some titles, so most statute citations are not linked.

source.publisher: Caselaw Access Project (Harvard Law School Library)

appended.reporters: F.2d, F. App'x, F.3d, F., B.R., Am. Tribal Law, F. Cas., F. Supp., U.S., Ohio Law Abs., Ohio Misc.
